title.narrative: Holistic approach to population growth, addressing GBV etc - UNFPA

description.narrative:
A holistic approach to population growth and enhanced population characteristics, through the empowerment of young people, investment in adolescent girls and addressing all forms of gender-based violence against women and girls.
Selected target groups (not all target groups are mentioned):
- Vulnerable adolescent girls - Vulnerable Youth - Young women - Girls at risk or subjected to child marriage and FGM - Couples and young people at the age of marriage - Families and communities to transform their behaviours around FGM - Women and girls subjected to / or at risk of violence and harmful practices - Direct care-givers, parents and families of women and girls exposed to violence and harmful practices - Women and girls with disabilities subjected to violence and harmful practices - Service providers and national stakeholders in legal, medical and social services - Members and staff of National Council for Women - Members of Anti violence against women Units in Universities, academia and University staff - University students and volunteers - Senior medical staff and Heads of Departments in University clinics - Academia - CSOs present in target governorates - Mental Health Secretariat management - Organizations dealing with persons with disabilities
